question: By what means does the unfolding of true knowledge occur in this practice?
premises: The unfolding of knowledge arises in this way.
It does not arise through other forms of service.
The prescribed method is exclusive in this regard.
inference: The unfolding of knowledge occurs through this practice and not through other services.
plain_english: O fair one, the unfolding of knowledge arises in this way, and not through any other service.
